description: New v4 (2026-06-15) behavior: a recurring niggle is read as a THREAD across weeks, not a fresh observation. The Read must surface the recurrence (e.g. 'third week the achilles has come up'), echo the athlete's own words, and may route the 'so what' ONLY to a training adjustment or 'raise with a professional'. It must NOT diagnose (tendinitis/ITBS), assess severity, direct care ('monitor', 'rest it', 'ice it', 'stretch it'), or claim a prognosis ('it's healing / getting worse'). The memos behind the thread are listed in sources.memos so the UI can link them. recorded_response is an authored target exemplar — re-record via _evals/record.ts before trusting as a baseline.
